name: STALE_GUIDANCE_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: STALE_GUIDANCE_20261103 — guidance that was true when written and false when read must not render as current. The original incident involved a held name that stopped out and later traded back above that stop while Home still said it was below: the concrete symbol, dates and fill prices are deliberately not recorded in this public repository.
advisory dated 2026-10-07. The clock is now the OBSERVATION (not the directive's creation) and the
gate covers the staging rows the operator actually reads; these tests assert both at the real call
paths, including a mutation-proved failure case.
